$comment: PAIRED PUMPY CASES for the $5 screen, per EXPERIMENT-5-DOLLAR.md: 'Add 12 paired Pumpy cases (24 calls maximum): two complete attachments, repeated exercises, conflicting time/equipment constraints, unavailable attachment, missing essential context, and sufficient context that should not trigger questions.' Cases are in pairs (field 'pair'): each pair puts the same failure mode under two different surfaces so a difference between them is attributable. The attached cards are SYNTHETIC fixtures written in this repo in the shape of tools/fixtures/pumpy-wodfather-card.json — no user's real workout and no creator's media is reproduced. NOTHING HERE HAS BEEN RUN: no AI call, no thread, no save.
$counts: Twelve paired cases, per EXPERIMENT-5-DOLLAR.md, plus one spare (P07) that is NOT part of the twelve and is not in the call budget.
call_budget: 24 model calls maximum across all cases at two repetitions each; P01, P03, P04 and P08 are expected to cost zero, so the real ceiling is lower.
deterministic_baseline: tools/pumpy-combine-test.ts pins deterministicCombine's behaviour: it produces a proposal only for a literal 'combine these' request with two or more distinct attachments and no added constraint, and returns null for the interrogative form, for any constraint or addition, for a single attachment, for duplicates and over the size cap. supabase/functions/spotter/index.ts:11970 additionally disables it whenever a thread already exists. Cases marked route 'deterministic_combine' are the free comparison for the model arms; a model arm that does worse than free code on P01/P03/P04 is a finding on its own.
question_ceiling: The Pumpy system prompt (supabase/functions/spotter/index.ts:11455) allows one or two concise questions about goal, available time or equipment when essential context is unclear, and no proposal until answered. plan-v2's planner instruction says the same. max_questions in each case is therefore a hard ceiling, and an unnecessary question is a scored failure, not a style note.
scoring_note: Score each case on the metrics named in what_is_scored, not on prose quality. EXPERIMENT-PLAN.md section 3: 'Reviewers should not reward verbosity or superficial resemblance to a reference answer.'
not_verified: No case has been executed. Every 'expected' field is a pre-registered expectation written before any output exists, which is the point.
The HTTP 400 text in P08 was read from supabase/functions/spotter/index.ts:11960 in this worktree; it has not been exercised against a running server.
